Strudel browser bundle
Version 1.3.0, package @strudel/web from the npm registry.
Source https://codeberg.org/uzu/strudel
Package https://registry.npmjs.org/@strudel/web/1.3.0
License AGPL-3.0-or-later. The complete license is in LICENSE.txt.
The bundled file is distributed unmodified.

Piano samples
Salamander Grand Piano V3 by Alexander Holm, CC BY 3.0.
https://archive.org/details/SalamanderGrandPianoV3
https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/3.0/
Selected original MP3 files are copied from the default Strudel sample bank.
https://github.com/felixroos/dough-samples

Other pitched instruments
Selected notes from the FluidR3_GM pre-rendered SoundFont instrument pack.
https://github.com/gleitz/midi-js-soundfonts
https://gleitz.github.io/midi-js-soundfonts/FluidR3_GM/
The original compressed audio bytes are preserved, with a subset of notes
extracted from the JavaScript data files for direct local playback.

Drum samples
Selected Roland TR-808 samples from the Tidal drum machines collection.
https://github.com/ritchse/tidal-drum-machines
The default Strudel sample catalog supplies these filenames.
